description.en: A soft lens that follows your cursor and redraws the live HTML beneath it as ascii characters.
description.zh: 柔和的透镜跟随光标，将下方的实时 HTML 重绘为 ASCII 字符。

discovery.caveat: 涉及实时 HTML 捕获，先查看详情中的浏览器要求与回退说明。

notice.en: Reference entry. This AI catalog does not redistribute component source. Install directly from the author's registry under its license; the @canvas-ui namespace belongs to the upstream author.
notice.zh: 来源收藏条目。本 AI 目录不重新分发组件源码；如需使用，请遵守作者许可并直接从作者的注册表安装。@canvas-ui 属于上游作者。

description.en: Radius of the ascii lens around the cursor, relative to the screen height.
description.zh: 指针周围 ASCII 镜片的半径，相对于屏幕高度。

description.en: Edge feather of the lens as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1).
description.zh: 镜片边缘羽化宽度，相对于半径的比例（0 至 1）。

description.en: Size of one glyph pixel in CSS pixels. Characters are 5x5 glyph pixels.
description.zh: 单个字形像素的 CSS 像素尺寸。字符由 5×5 个字形像素构成。

description.en: Empty glyph pixels around each character (0 to 3).
description.zh: 每个字符周围的空白字形像素数（0 至 3）。

description.en: Built-in character ramp: real ascii glyphs, shade blocks, or binary digits.
description.zh: 内置字符梯度：真实 ASCII 字符、阴影方块或二进制数字。

description.en: Custom ramp of packed 5x5 bitmaps (dark to bright), overrides charset.
description.zh: 从暗到亮排列的自定义 5×5 位图梯度，覆盖 charset。

description.en: Paper color behind the glyphs as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range, or "auto" to match the page background.
description.zh: 字形后方的底色，使用 0 至 1 范围的 [r, g, b]，或设为 auto 匹配页面背景。

description.en: Opacity of the background behind the glyphs (0 to 1).
description.zh: 字形后方背景的不透明度（0 至 1）。

description.en: Contrast applied to character density before picking a glyph.
description.zh: 选择字形前应用到字符密度的对比度。

description.en: Density offset applied before picking a glyph (-1 to 1).
description.zh: 选择字形前应用的密度偏移（-1 至 1）。

description.en: Invert character density inside the effect (0 to 1).
description.zh: 效果区域中的字符密度反转程度（0 至 1）。

description.en: Coverage of asciified cells inside the lens (0 to 1).
description.zh: 镜片内 ASCII 单元的覆盖比例（0 至 1）。

description.en: Ascii coverage across the whole screen, outside the lens (0 to 1).
description.zh: 镜片外整个屏幕的 ASCII 覆盖比例（0 至 1）。

description.en: How quickly the lens follows the cursor. Higher is snappier.
description.zh: 镜片跟随指针的速度。值越高，响应越直接。

description.en: Soft phosphor glow around the text dots (0 to 1).
description.zh: 文字像素周围柔和的荧光强度（0 至 1）。

description.en: Soft chromatic aberration toward the lens edge (0 to 1).
description.zh: 朝镜片边缘增加的柔和色差（0 至 1）。

dependencies.frameworkNote: Solid uses solid-js; Preact uses preact. Other framework dependencies follow the target project.

install.behavior: Commands are metadata only. This catalog and CLI never execute installation.

browserNotes: WebGPU builds need a browser with WebGPU; verify the current browser support before choosing a renderer.
HTML-in-Canvas is experimental. Check the component's current upstream browser/fallback documentation. Do not assume DOM capture works in every browser.
